category.name: Neurologic
category.part: AME Physical Examination Information and Disposition Tables

what_to_bring: 49% or less blockage (both sides)
no symptoms
no ongoing treatment with DOAC/NOAC or coumadin
no current problems that would interfere with flight duties:

A detailed Clinical Progress Note performed within 90 days of exam from the treating physician (cardiologist, neurologist, or PCP). It should include a detailed summary of the history of the condition or diagnosis, treatments and outcomes, current medications, physical exam findings, all pertinent test results obtained, assessment, plan, and follow up.
It must specifically include if there has been any clinically significant increase in stenosis that would prompt a change in treatment or surveillance.
Vascular imaging (such as CTA, MRA, or angiogram) of head and neck performed no more than 90 days prior to AME exam.
MRI brain (with or without contrast) performed no more than 90 days prior to AME exam.
Other testing: Any deemed clinically necessary by the treating physician
Cardiovascular risk assessment to review risk factors and include testing indicated within the previous one year. [see Protocol for Cardiovascular Evaluation (CVE)].

  • 4. MRI brain (with or without contrast) performed no more than 90 days prior to AME exam.

Note: Stress testing may be required in some cases or when clinically indicated.

caci_worksheets.title: CACI – Carotid / Vertebral Artery Stenosis Worksheet

criteria.ame_must_review: A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note from the treating physician performed no more than 90 days prior to AME exam finds:
criteria.acceptable_certification_criteria: [ ] Condition is stable with NO symptoms. AND [ ] There has been NO clinically significant increase in stenosis that would prompt a change in treatment or surveillance NOTE: History of stroke or TIA, are not CACI. See corresponding page.
[ ] Carotid / Vertebral Artery Stenosis OR [ ] Carotid / Vertebral Artery Stenosis surveillance 2 or more years AFTER surgery to correct stenosis (carotid endarterectomy, stent, etc.)

criteria.ame_must_review: Imaging Carotid ultrasound, CT Angiogram (CTA), Magnetic resonance angiography (MRA), or angiogram
criteria.acceptable_certification_criteria: [ ] 79% or less on both sides (right and left) AND [ ] performed within the previous ONE YEAR

criteria.ame_must_review: Medications for condition (any combination of the following)
criteria.acceptable_certification_criteria: [ ] None [ ] ASA (aspirin) [ ] Plavix or Brilinta (ASA allowed in combination) Note: DOAC/NOAC/coumadin do not qualify for CACI, see Special Issuance guidelines, row C
